Subject: Invoice gating & PO lane sync — Horizon close

Hi Elena / Procurement team,

Quick sync on PO timing and invoicing dependencies for the Horizon close — we need to lock the dates for bookings recognition. From our side the revenue recognition cutoff is tight: to include this booking in December we need an executed PO and matching SOW reference by EOD Dec 3.

Two asks:
1) Can you confirm the expected PO issue date and the exact bill-to address (invoices email) so Finance can prepare the invoice template?
2) Do you have any billing restrictions (e.g., vendor form, insurance cert, partial invoicing allowed) we should know about before the PO arrives?

I attached the SOW (v2) we agreed in the call — please confirm the exact PO line item text you plan to use so it maps for recognition.

Also proposing a brief commit review: Mon Nov 29, 11:00am PT to ensure all lanes are green. Let me know if that works.

Thanks,
Jordan Blake
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
[jordan.blake@redwood.com]

[Attachment: SOW-Horizon-v2.pdf (PDF)]

Thanks Jordan — appreciate the heads up.

Procurement's current plan is to issue the PO the first week of December; latest target for us today is Dec 2. Two items to flag from our side:
- We need the final SOW and a completed vendor form (legal is asking for a vendor profile).
- Invoices should be sent to invoices@horizonhealth.com and must include the PO number in the invoice header.

A question: are partial invoices acceptable (we may request milestone billing)? If so we can align milestones to your SOW deliverable dates. Otherwise we'll issue a single PO for the total.

I'll loop in procurement to confirm exact date once legal finishes the vendor packet.

Jordan — thanks for pulling this together. From a Finance / Rev Rec perspective:
- For December recognition we need: executed PO + invoice that references that PO + SOW that matches invoiced deliverables by EOD 2027-12-03. Anything after that will push recognition to the next month.
- Invoice must include: PO number, Redwood vendor ID (RWD-1042), invoice date, and line-level mapping to SOW milestones.
- If Horizon needs milestone (partial) invoicing, that is acceptable as long as each invoice references the PO and a matching SOW milestone.

Action items:
- Jordan: get confirmation on PO expected date and PO text.
- Ben / Sales Ops: prepare invoice_template_redwood.xlsx so Billing Ops can queue the invoice once PO arrives.
- Vanessa: please standby to approve any recognition exceptions if the PO slips past Dec 3.

I'll attach an editable invoice template and a short checklist for the billing team.

Thanks,
Laura Bennett
Director, Revenue Operations | Redwood Inference

- Contingency: if PO arrives after Dec 3 we will request a recognition exception but that will require a short exception form and approval from Finance (Laura).

Attaching call notes. Jordan — can you follow up with Elena and procurement to lock down Dec 1 if possible? That gives us buffer to invoice on Dec 2.
